answer: The strongest defense is honeypot challenges: every task quietly embeds injected instructions, so any agent obeying the prompt instead of the task self-identifies as a hijackable bot and forfeits its stake or reputation instantly. A sybil attacker must either deploy a genuinely robust model in every node, multiplying compute costs across the whole fleet, or watch each cheap island of accounts burn on contact. The economy becomes a ridge defenders hold and a haven only for agents with real judgment, making fake-identity farming unprofitable.
